summary:

Changes: rich/tree.py (Tree.__rich_measure__, iterative with explicit stack, Measurement import); rich/align.py (Align width constraint, Align.__repr__, new VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr); rich/console.py (print uses justify="default" in render options); CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked Unreleased, Added subsection with two entries); tests/test_align.py (VerticalCenter import, repr, render, measure, and no-attribute-error tests); tests/test_tree.py (Measurement import, acceptance-example tree test, single-node test).
